name: LinuxVR-ViewShot
author: yakuda
description: Shows the translations of LinuxVR-ViewShot (VR photos with a hand-frame gesture on Linux) in your chatbox. Take a photo of a sign in VR, ViewShot translates it, and the translation appears in the chatbox for 2-10 seconds - then the chatbox goes back to what you normally send. Gets the text by OSC (port 9025) or from ViewShot's translation.json. Needs ViewShot 1.0.1+ with Options -> General -> Output switched on.
short_description: ViewShot translations in the chatbox for a few seconds, then back to normal.

text: [LinuxVR-ViewShot](https://github.com/yakuda-stack/LinuxVR-ViewShot) takes photos in VR with a hand-frame gesture and translates the text in them.
This plugin puts every new translation **into your chatbox for a few seconds** (2-10, your choice).
When the time is up, the chatbox shows your normal lines again by itself.
1. In ViewShot: **Options → General → Output** – switch on **Send via OSC** (port `9025`) *or* **Write to a file**.
2. Here: pick the same source. Defaults fit ViewShot's defaults.
3. Press **Test** – the test line should appear in the chatbox.
- **Replace the chatbox** – only the translation, then back (default)
- **On top** – the translation above your normal lines
- **Only the placeholder** – put `{linuxvr_viewshot_translation}` where you want it
Long translations are cut at 144 characters. 🔁 Lens (live translation) sends again only when the text changed.
OSC is only received from this PC (127.0.0.1).

placeholders.translation: the translation (with prefix) - only while it is shown, then empty
placeholders.original: the recognised original text - only while shown
placeholders.source: photo / lens / test - only while shown
placeholders.last: the latest translation, stays until the next one

settings.label: Status
settings.hint: Where the plugin is listening right now.

settings.label: Get translations by
settings.hint: Must match ViewShot: Options → General → Output.

settings.label: OSC port
settings.hint: Same port as in ViewShot. Not 9000/9001 - those belong to VRChat. Only this PC can send here (127.0.0.1).

settings.label: File
settings.hint: Same file as in ViewShot. A new translation is noticed by its id, even with the same text.

settings.label: Show for
settings.hint: How long the translation stays in the chatbox before your normal lines come back.

choices.label: On top of your normal lines

items.label: Prefix
items.hint: In front of the translation. Empty = none.

items.label: Everything in one line
items.hint: Joins the lines of a long translation with · – saves chatbox lines.

items.label: Also the original text
items.hint: original ➜ translation. Costs characters - long texts get cut at 144.

items.label: 🔁 Lens (live translation)
items.hint: Lens sends again every time the text changes - turn off if that is too much for the chatbox.

settings.label: Try it
settings.hint: Shows a test line in the chatbox for the time set above.
